items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: Dr. Tudry raised me. ... Ralph and Dr. Tudry doctored me. He brought me up to a big man. He called you Booker T? He named me Booker T.

ctx.x: How did you get your nickname, Booker T?

Dr. Tudry raised me. Dr. Tudry raised me. Dr. Tudry raised me. Dr. Tudry raised me. I used to drive him around the horse and buggy. You see, a long time ago we didn't have no automobiles. They didn't have no automobiles. But I used to drive him around the horse and buggy. Sometimes he'd be out there one, two o'clock in the morning before he could get around to your house. So he'd make all that route. And I used to drive him in a horse and buggy. He still, his son is living. I believe his son was, his son Tudry.…
Booker T. Booker T, yeah. Booker T. We got the third reel on there, Buck, but we never did get about how Big Eye Louie got his nickname.
